appDescription: An in-vehicle app that prepares, runs, and reports a parked rest session without bypassing user approval.

function.name: NARU_COMMA_PROPOSE_SETTINGS
function.description: Proposes one or more settings for a parked rest session and opens the app for user confirmation.

durationMinutes.description: The total planned rest duration in minutes.

targetTemperatureCelsius.description: The requested absolute cabin target temperature in degrees Celsius.

temperatureDeltaCelsius.description: The requested relative cabin target temperature change in degrees Celsius.

screenBrightnessPercent.description: The requested app screen brightness from zero to one hundred percent.

ambientLightPercent.description: The requested vehicle ambient light brightness from zero to one hundred percent.

restSound.description: The requested sound played during the rest session.

function.name: NARU_COMMA_EXTEND_REST
function.description: Proposes extending the active rest session and opens the app for user confirmation.

minutes.description: The extension duration in minutes, limited by the app to five or ten minutes.

function.name: NARU_COMMA_GET_STATUS
function.description: Returns the current stage and remaining time of the parked rest session.
